seo.title: Truthify — AI argument analysis
seo.description: Truthify case study: text and YouTube transcript analysis, progressive argument feedback, and a Next.js, OpenAI, and PostgreSQL architecture.

hero.hook: Explore text reliability, one claim at a time
hero.description: Truthify extracts claims from text, assigns an estimated reliability level, and helps readers locate each passage in the original content.

overview.problem: A series of claims can be hard to examine without losing track of its context, especially in long texts or video transcripts.
overview.solution: Truthify splits content into chunks, submits them to an OpenAI model, and displays claim cards, scores out of ten, and highlights in the original text.
overview.audience: People looking to review claims and reasoning
overview.role: Full-stack design and development of the project
overview.scope: UI, analysis API, YouTube extraction, persistence, accounts and payments

visual.title: Text or transcript
visual.description: Paste text or enter a YouTube URL; manual text entry remains available if transcript retrieval fails. Two input modes in a single analysis interface.

visual.title: Incremental processing
visual.description: The service splits text into overlapping chunks and streams progress to the browser as each analysis completes. Progress sent through SSE events.

visual.title: Claim-level results
visual.description: View an overall score and extracted claims, each with a reliability category and available explanation. A score out of ten, a category, and an explanation for each claim.

visual.title: Contextual navigation
visual.description: Browse highlighted passages and open their associated cards while keeping the original text in view. Links between original excerpts and assessment cards.

architecture.description: The React client calls a Next.js SSE route, which orchestrates OpenAI analysis and stores results and cache in PostgreSQL through Prisma.

challenges.title: Handle longer texts
challenges.constraint: A single request would be sensitive to input length and processing time.
challenges.solution: Overlapping chunks with explicit limits on text length and the number of chunks.

challenges.title: Make processing visible
challenges.constraint: Analyzing multiple chunks yields results at different times.
challenges.solution: A Server-Sent Events route and React hook expose progress and newly extracted claims.

challenges.title: Connect scores to source text
challenges.constraint: An isolated assessment lacks context if the user cannot find the original passage.
challenges.solution: Excerpt position matching and interactive highlighting connected to result cards.

challenges.title: Retrieve YouTube transcripts
challenges.constraint: Transcript retrieval depends on external sources and can fail depending on the video.
challenges.solution: A cascade of retrieval strategies, transcript caching, and manual text entry when retrieval fails.

outcomes.title: Progressive analysis interface
outcomes.description: Input workflow, chunk-level progress, overall score and assessment cards linked to the text.

outcomes.title: Persistence and reuse
outcomes.description: Analyses stored with Prisma in PostgreSQL, with caching based on a hash of normalized text.

outcomes.title: Service management foundation
outcomes.description: Magic-link authentication, account area, Stripe checkout sessions and signed webhook handling.
